description: This file is a Java source code defining the implementation of ChargeReadPlatformService, including methods to retrieve various charge data, handle database queries, and map result sets for charge-related information in the Fineract project.

classes.name: ChargeReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ChargeReadPlatformService interface that provides methods to retrieve and manage charge data from the database, including mapping database records to ChargeData objects.

methods.name: retrieveAllCharges
methods.description: Fetches all non-deleted charges with optional office-specific filtering, ordered by name.

methods.name: retrieveAllChargesForCurrency
methods.description: Retrieves charges filtered by a specific currency code.

methods.name: retrieveCharge
methods.description: Fetches a specific charge by its ID, throws an exception if not found.

methods.name: retrieveNewChargeDetails
methods.description: Gathers and returns metadata and options needed to create a new charge, including currencies, calculation types, applicable entities, accounts, and tax groups.

methods.name: retrieveLoanProductCharges
methods.description: Retrieves charges applicable to a specific loan product, with optional filtering by charge time type.

methods.name: retrieveLoanApplicableFees
methods.description: Retrieves loan charges that are applicable as fees (non-penalty).

methods.name: retrieveLoanAccountApplicableCharges
methods.description: Retrieves applicable charges for a specific loan account, excluding specified charge times.

methods.name: processChargeExclusionsForLoans
methods.description: Helper to build exclusion clause for charge retrievals based on charge time exclusions.

methods.name: retrieveLoanProductApplicableCharges
methods.description: Retrieves charges for a specific loan product, excluding specified charge times.

methods.name: retrieveLoanApplicablePenalties
methods.description: Retrieves penalty charges applicable to loans.

methods.name: addInClauseToSQL_toLimitChargesMappedToOffice_ifOfficeSpecificProductsEnabled
methods.description: Conditionally adds an SQL IN clause to limit charges to those mapped to the user's offices if entity-specific charges are enabled.

methods.name: retrieveSavingsProductApplicableCharges
methods.description: Retrieves applicable savings charges, optionally excluding penalties.

methods.name: retrieveSavingsApplicablePenalties
methods.description: Retrieves penalty charges applicable to savings products.

methods.name: retrieveSavingsProductCharges
methods.description: Retrieves charges for a specific savings product.

methods.name: retrieveShareProductCharges
methods.description: Retrieves charges for a specific share product.

methods.name: retrieveSavingsAccountApplicableCharges
methods.description: Retrieves charges applicable to a specific savings account.
